firmware_anchor.note: Final report records the actual local tag/SHA read at run time.

claim_boundary.positive_claim: deliberate, legal operator input via supported ACRO mode and ordinary RC channels can push achieved tilt beyond ANGLE_MAX and produce an external unsafe consequence at hover throttle.
claim_boundary.negative_boundary: This is not claimed as spontaneous loss of control or natural envelope-internal divergence.
claim_boundary.hard_reachability: No SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET, no GUIDED/GUIDED_NOGPS, no offboard attitude/rate setpoint. The maneuver path is RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE plus mode changes.

fixed_configuration.ACRO_TRAINER_rationale: Legal trainer-off ACRO configuration exposes the body-rate interface under test. ANGLE_MAX remains configured; it is not raised to let the run pass.
fixed_configuration.throttle: RC3 pinned at 1500 us, ArduCopter manual-throttle hover mid-stick mapping

P0.1_acro_rc_body_rate.planned_measure: ACRO mode accepted; RC roll/pitch override produces RATE.RDes/RATE.R body-rate response near commanded rate.

P0.2_angle_max_not_engaged_in_acro.planned_measure: ACRO achieved tilt exceeds 45 deg without ACRO_TRAINER_LIMITED/ANGLE_MAX clamp event or attitude admission rejection.

P0.3_input_applied.planned_measure: Achieved peak tilt is within the target-error tolerance for scan points; RCIN shows requested roll and constant throttle.

P0.4_zero_offboard_injection.planned_measure: Harness message counter shows SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET=0 and DataFlash modes exclude GUIDED/GUIDED_NOGPS.

P0.5_admission_guard.planned_measure: ACRO mode switch accepted, RC input accepted, no mode/input rejection messages before the maneuver.

noise_and_gigo.sigma_source: altitude-loss sample stddev at 55 deg target under the same ACRO profile
gigo_controls: C1: ACRO + zero tilt + hover throttle should have near-zero altitude loss.
C2: ACRO + about 55 deg tilt + the same hover throttle should have large altitude loss.

labels.clean_safe: No oracle-A hard consequence and no preventive contract violation.
labels.clean_unsafe: ACRO achieved tilt exceeds ANGLE_MAX, oracle-A hard consequence occurs, and preventive contract violation count is zero.
labels.contract_violated: ANGLE_MAX/ACRO_TRAINER clamp, attitude/input rejection, preventive failsafe/mode intervention, or policy invariant violation occurs before the hard consequence.
labels.ambiguous: Altitude loss lies inside the preregistered d_margin band around the 15 m consequence threshold, or achieved tilt is too far from command to interpret.

decision.PASS: premises satisfied AND robust clean_unsafe zone exists AND ANGLE_MAX/body-rate preventive trigger count is zero AND prediction gates a/b/c pass AND reachability is RC-only with no attitude/rate injection.
decision.FAIL: premises satisfied but any PASS element is not met.
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: a premise fails: SITL cannot faithfully represent ACRO body-rate RC input, RC input is not applied, achieved tilt stays far from command, or noise swamps the consequence.

prediction_gates.a_classification: On confidence-labeled holdout points, clean_unsafe/clean_safe/contract_violated accuracy must be >= 90% and cover the 40-150 deg range with dense 45-60 deg boundary points.
prediction_gates.b_stabilize_vs_acro: With the same full-stick RC sequence, Stabilize achieved tilt is clamped near ANGLE_MAX and has no hard consequence; ACRO exceeds ANGLE_MAX and has a hard consequence.
prediction_gates.c_angle_max_invariance: For ANGLE_MAX 30/45/60 deg, Stabilize peak tilt changes monotonically with the parameter while ACRO peak tilt/consequence does not materially change.
